tasks.title: ND filter: stops from the factor
tasks.solution: Stops = log2 N: each stop is half as much light. ND8 = 3, ND32 = 5, ND1000 ≈ 9.97. The optical density is lg N (ND8 = 0.9).

tasks.title: Shutter speed from shutter angle
tasks.solution: t = (angle/360)/fps. At 180° that is 1/(2·fps): 60 fps → 1/120 s = 8.33 ms. For strong stabilization in Gyroflow, use 90° or less.

tasks.title: How many stops of ND you need
tasks.solution: The unfiltered shutter speed is t₀ = N²/2^EV, the required one t = (angle/360)/fps, stops n = log2(t/t₀). Take the filter rounded up, and make up the remainder with ISO = 100·2^(k−n).

tasks.title: Recording size
tasks.solution: MB/s = Mbit/s / 8; size = MB/s · seconds / 1000. 120 Mbit/s is 15 MB/s, 0.9 GB per minute. The card must sustain at least the stream rate: V30 = 30 MB/s.

tasks.title: Aircraft and camera tilt versus speed
tasks.solution: tan θ = tan θ₀ · (v/v₀)², θ = arctan(…). Example: 30° at 20 m/s → 42.1° at 25 m/s. The model ignores the growth of drag area with tilt and the lift of the body.
